title: Making room for an unknown possibility

captions.physics: Creating a dependable opening for involvement

meaning: Your involvement can sustain hope when dependable preparation allows something new without requiring its value to be proved beforehand.
text: You need not know the result in advance to help an important wish find a place. In the physical position of Anahata, the Emperor expresses care through definite actions: preparing space, keeping an agreement and accepting clear responsibility. The Fool in energy brings openness to trying without a ready programme or certainty about the outcome. The Star in emotions offers hope, a sense of possibility beyond the familiar. Tenderness can mean not requiring a new idea to prove its value first. Support appears for a wish that is not yet fully formed or easy to explain convincingly.

Suppose one person has long drawn privately but never displayed the work at home. You offer to clear a small wall and choose together what might hang there. **Dependable involvement can support a wish that is still uncertain.** Prepared fittings and available space make the offer real. You can choose one drawing, change your mind or leave part of the wall empty. Warmth lies in trying without making the corner prove artistic success.

The difficulty is falling too quickly in love with the next possibility. You want more pictures, visitors and another step, although a small attempt is enough for the person now. Hope outruns agreement and support starts hurrying. Care stays considerate when it can stop at the size of opportunity actually welcomed today without devaluing its modest scale.
